title: Stripe Churn Alert
summary: Detect Stripe subscription cancellations, look up the customer in HubSpot, classify the churn reason with AI, and post an alert to Slack with a HubSpot note.
seoTitle: Stripe Subscription Churn Alert to Slack and HubSpot
answer: This template listens for Stripe subscription webhooks indicating a cancellation (when cancel_at_period_end is set), looks up the customer and company in HubSpot by email or Stripe customer ID, uses an AI agent to classify the likely churn reason from subscription metadata and customer notes, posts a Slack alert to a designated channel with per-run deduplication, and logs the churn event as a note in HubSpot so your CS team can see the full context in one place.

faq.q: Can Stripe or HubSpot send churn alerts natively?
faq.a: Stripe can email billing events, and HubSpot offers workflow notifications, but neither combines subscription cancellation detection, AI-powered churn reason classification, Slack alerts to account owners, and automatic CRM note logging in one workflow. This template delivers instant, context-rich churn alerts.

faq.q: How does the AI classify churn reasons?
faq.a: The AI agent reads the subscription plan name, cancellation feedback from Stripe metadata (if you collect it), the customer's payment history flags, and any HubSpot notes about the account, then classifies the churn as price, product, service, competitor, or other. You can customize the classification logic by editing the agent instructions.

faq.q: What if the customer is not found in HubSpot?
faq.a: The workflow logs a warning and still posts the Slack alert with Stripe customer details. You can add a fallback step to create a new HubSpot contact automatically if needed.

faq.q: How does the Slack alert work?
faq.a: The workflow posts the alert to the channel you specify. Per-run deduplication prevents duplicate alerts within one run.

faq.q: Does this template prevent the cancellation?
faq.a: No. The template notifies your team when a cancellation occurs so they can follow up before the subscription ends. Stripe still processes the cancellation at the end of the billing period.

sampleOutput: Slack message: Churn Alert: Acme Corp cancelled Pro plan ($299/mo). Reason: Price sensitivity. Subscription ends Dec 31. HubSpot note posted. View in HubSpot.
whatYouNeed: Stripe integration connected in Ballet, HubSpot integration connected, Slack Bot integration connected, and invite the Slack bot to your churn alert channel
failureHandling: The Stripe webhook responds immediately to avoid timeouts. If HubSpot or Slack API calls fail, the workflow retries automatically. Failed runs appear in history with error details.
nativeVsTemplate: Use Stripe's built-in email notifications if you only need simple cancellation alerts. Use this template when you want AI-powered churn reason classification, Slack alerts, and automatic HubSpot logging so your CS team has full context without switching tools.
setup: Connect the Stripe, HubSpot, and Slack Bot integrations in Ballet once.
In HubSpot, create a custom contact property 'stripe_churn_notes' (single-line text) under Settings > Properties > Contact Properties to store churn notes.
Invite the Slack bot to your churn alert channel.
Publish the playbook and copy the webhook URL from Studio.
In Stripe dashboard, add the webhook URL and subscribe to customer.subscription.updated and customer.subscription.deleted events.
Test by cancelling a test subscription and watching the run.
